description: Preview or explicitly confirm a sync with Anki's configured server. A full sync may require the user to choose Upload or Download in Anki. Returns an operation ID, not completion. Requires AnkiConnect v1.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approves the reviewed collection operation.

confirmationToken.description: Short-lived, one-use token returned by this tool's preview.

dryRun.description: Review the active profile and proposal without running the operation.

includeMedia.description: Request media sync, if enabled in the active profile.

name: sync-collection

includeMedia.description: Requested media option for sync; null for other operations.

title: Synchronize the active Anki collection
